messages.subject: Rhipe 0.69
parts:
Can now be found at

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/downloads

New stuff in rhread, rhwatch, rhmr. Also this new way of invoking
commands is pretty useful.


m <- rhmap({
rhcollect(sample(1:5,1), sample(1:5,1))
})
r <- rhoptions()$templates$rbinder(
{
rhcollect(reduce.key, list(all=adata,mean=mean(adata[,1])))
})
z <- rhwatch(rhmr(map=m, reduce=r,combine=FALSE, N=10))

The above outputs random number from 1;5, associated with a key from 1:5
The reducer assembles these into data frame and computes the mean.

Other reducers are rhoptions()$templates${scalar summer, range, colsummer}

rhwatch has debug facilities
rhwatch can also take user code to monitor the execution etc.


Cheers
Saptarshi
